title: Can the owner take out part of a certificate before maturity?
content:
## Scope

This part of the Certificates of Deposit early withdrawal policy governs an early partial withdrawal, that is, taking part of the principal out of a certificate before maturity. Each tier supplies its own setting for whether partial withdrawals are allowed, the smallest partial withdrawal, the principal that must remain and the most partial withdrawals per term.

## Policy clause

Partial withdrawals are allowed only where the tier allows partial early withdrawal, for at least the tier's smallest partial withdrawal, leaving at least the tier's principal that must remain, and no more than the tier's most partial withdrawals per term. A request breaking any of these is declined, never converted.

## How the term count is taken

The count of partial withdrawals in a term is the number of early partial withdrawals posted in the current term, from the term start date through the current date.

## Checklist for one request

| Condition | Met when |
|---|---|
| Tier allows partial early withdrawal | The tier's setting is "Yes" |
| Size of the request | At least the tier's smallest partial withdrawal |
| Principal left behind | At least the tier's principal that must remain |
| Count in the term | This withdrawal keeps the term's early partial withdrawals within the tier's most per term |

All four must be met; if any one is not, the request is declined.

## Cases (hypothetical tier limits and balances)

Assume, for illustration only, a tier that allows partial withdrawals with a smallest partial withdrawal of S, a principal that must remain of R and at most N partial withdrawals per term.

- **Request smaller than S.** Declined. It is not raised to S.
- **Request that would leave less than R.** Declined. It is not cut back to leave R, and it is not turned into a full withdrawal.
- **The term already holds N early partial withdrawals.** A further partial request is declined, because it would exceed N.
- **Tier that does not allow partial withdrawals.** Any partial request is declined; it is not converted into a full withdrawal.

## Points of judgement

**The owner asks for more than the certificate can release as a partial. Does the bank release what it can?**
No. A request breaking any condition is declined, never converted.

**Do partial withdrawals from an earlier term count toward this term's limit?**
No. The count covers only the current term, from its term start date through the current date.
